name: Hello MERNPress
author: The MERNPress team
description: This is not just a plugin; it symbolizes the hope and enthusiasm of an entire project summed up in two words sung most famously by Louis Armstrong: Hello, MERNPress. When activated you will randomly see a lyric from the MERNPress songbook in the upper right of your admin screen on every page.
details: Shows a rotating lyric in the admin toolbar.
toolbarLyrics: It's so nice to have you back where you belong
You're lookin' swell, MERNPress, we can tell, MERNPress
You're still glowin', you're still crowin', you're still goin' strong
Blocks in the editor, posts on the wire
It's so nice to have you back where you belong
